caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a detailed pencil illustration of a leaping dog. The dog is shown in profile, facing to the left, with all four legs extended outward as if in mid-run or jump. The body is elongated, and the chest and ribs are distinctly marked with shading and lines to indicate muscle and form. The tail is pointed, and the head is lowered with the ear hanging down. The dog is supported by a vertical pole beneath its belly, suggesting it may be a model or a sculpture. The drawing is monochromatic, utilizing varying shades of gray created by pencil shading for texture, contour, and depth. There is a rectangular border around the image, and within this border, at the lower left corner, there is a small, finely drawn scale for measurement. The name "GORDON SANBORN" is written in block letters near the bottom right within the border. The background is left plain and unshaded.
title: Running Dog Weather Vane
